scope: Independent audit of Warden isolated spherical TG BVP, uniform-density threshold, radial stability, units, and sign branches. No observational fit or source reconstruction was run.

source.title: Pszota and Van, Field Equation of Thermodynamic Gravity and Galactic Rotational Curves

assumptions.source: prescribed static spherical density; uniform-density test has S=4*pi*G*rho for r<R and zero outside
assumptions.matching: continuous u,u-prime at sharp source edge R; exact vacuum exterior for stationary solution

uniform_sphere_K_positive.at_critical: no finite amplitude matches the affine isolated-gauge boundary; A=sec(x) and B diverge; the local interior Riccati g(R) remains finite at -1/(K*R)
uniform_sphere_K_positive.above_first_critical: the unique matched interior is negative at the center immediately above pi/2; later branches have nodes; not an admissible positive exponential transform

finite_source_domain_with_instantaneous_.classification: negative below first threshold, zero at threshold, positive above

full_space_diffusion_exterior.classification: zero-energy decaying exterior 1/r matching has the same first threshold x=pi/2; subcritical spectrum has a continuum ending at zero, so no isolated finite-domain exponential decay rate
full_space_diffusion_exterior.caveat: the instantaneous static Robin boundary is not the exact time-dependent exterior Dirichlet-to-Neumann condition

sign_branches.K_positive_printed_equation: oscillatory sine/cot branch; the paper's positive-K coth Eq. 23 is not a solution of its printed Eq. 8 under that sign convention (also found by the campaign audit)
sign_branches.K_negative: put y=R*sqrt(abs(K)*S0); u=sech(y)*sinh(sqrt(abs(K)*S0)*r)/(sqrt(abs(K)*S0)*r), B/R=tanh(y)/y-1; positive for all finite y, no pi/2 threshold
sign_branches.K_zero: use original Poisson equation; Cole-Hopf variable degenerates and expressions dividing by K are invalid

numeric_checks_normalized_R_D_K.reason: negative central u and positive radial growth mode

warden_claim_audit.stationary_equation_and_robin: correct under compact-source and u(infinity)=1 assumptions
warden_claim_audit.uniform_positive_K_threshold: correct for a uniform sphere; do not apply via mean density to arbitrary profiles
warden_claim_audit.leading_relaxation_mode: finite-domain Robin eigenvalue is correct for instantaneous quasi-static exterior; full-space diffusion has continuum to zero, though same first instability threshold
warden_claim_audit.NGC_source_geometry: a SPARC pseudo-spherical inversion is conditional, not a unique physical 3D source; preserve signed gas terms and do not clip negative inferred density

paper_crossover_mass_note.equations: Eq. 17 implies R_K=K*G*M_aa; Eq. 66 instead inserts M_aa,K=0
paper_crossover_mass_note.verdict: Warden correctly flags a mass-definition substitution; do not quote 33.3 kpc as the fitted branch's exact crossover radius

recommendation: Proceed only with Warden Test 1 as a bounded conditional spherical-surrogate viability check. Declare rho interpolation/taper and signed-density handling before looking at residuals; evaluate the paper K/M-to-light point and bounded profile; use the isolated Robin condition without observed endpoint velocities; check u positivity, principal radial growth eigenvalue, full-vs-quasistatic exterior interpretation, and convergence. This task did not run that fit and does not support a physical NGC 3198 or TG detection claim.
